WORDS: Thomas Nelson, ca.1901. MUSIC: Ora H. Teasley; har., ca.1901. Public Domain.

Jesus... said, Suffer little children to come unto me, and forbid them not: for of such is the kingdom of God. Lk. 18:16 Ye fathers, provoke not your children to wrath: but bring them up in the nurture and admonition of the Lord. Eph. 6:4
